v-c98c5217279b.name: Wide run rail
v-c98c5217279b.rule: Spend horizontal rail width to fit active runs into a shorter two-column list

v-d0683e8e607a.name: Tabs with overflow
v-d0683e8e607a.rule: Keep Scope and Runs direct while moving additional workspace contexts behind an explicit More control

workspace-activity-board.rule: Replace the central workspace with a dedicated scrollable run board

workspace-activity-drawer.rule: Open a full-height scrollable run drawer from the activity rail

workspace-activity-inline.rule: Keep scope visible while expanding a scrollable run list inside the same secondary rail

workspace-activity-rail.rule: Open active runs from an activity-rail popover

workspace-activity-split.rule: Replace only the source pane with a scrollable run list while keeping the graph visible

workspace-activity-switcher.rule: Replace the secondary scope rail with a scrollable active-run list

workspace-activity-tabs.rule: Put Scope and Runs tabs directly above the controlled rail content

workspace-header.rule: Overlay active runs from the workspace header

comparisons.reason: A persistent rail scales better than a popover when the run list may contain 30 entries.
The switcher keeps the run control beside the rail it changes; the split pane puts the control far from the controlled run list.
Context tabs keep the control adjacent to the content, but the preference depends on how many workspace contexts must become tabs.
Context tabs use the existing secondary rail; the overflow challenger adds vertical navigation and this workspace should spend horizontal room rather than vertical room.
Context tabs preserve graph/source space and use the existing secondary rail; the wide rail reduced vertical scrolling but consumed unnecessary horizontal space.

decision: Workspace-wide active-run management without weakening the graph-first Procedure workspace

tabPolicy.reason: Context tabs preserve graph/source space and keep the control beside the scrollable rail content.
tabPolicy.trigger: Use the inline run list if additional contexts make the tab strip too crowded.
